tha-ap512:1.1: Nāḷikeradāyaka.] Nagare Bandhumatiyā ārāmiko ahaṃ tadā / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ gacchantaṃ anilañjase. // //
tha-ap512:2.1: Nāḷikeraphalaṃ gayha Buddhaseṭṭhass' adās' ahaṃ / ākāse ṭhitako santo patigaṇhi mahāyaso // //
tha-ap512:3.1: Vittisañjanano mayhaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhāvaho / phalaṃ Buddhassa datvāna vippasannena cetasā. // //
tha-ap512:4.1: Adhigacchiṃ tadā pītiṃ vipulañ ca sukhuttamaṃ / uppajjate va ratanaṃ nibbattassa yahiṃ tahiṃ. // //
tha-ap512:5.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap512:6.1: Dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ visuddham me samādhikusalo ahaṃ / abhiññāpāramippatto phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap512:10.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Nāḷikaradāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap512:14.1: Kaṇikār'-Ekapatto ca Kāsumārī tath' Āvaṭaṃ Pārañ ca Mātuluṅgañ ca Ajel' Āmoram-eva ca
tha-ap512:15.1: Tālaṃ tathā Nāḷikeraṃ gāthāyo gaṇitā-v-iha ekaṃ gāthā sataṃ hoti ūnādhika-vivajjitaṃ.
